messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@byteforge.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits & qualification for ByteForge accelerator

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week — we loved the throughput and latency profile on the sample workload. ByteForge has been accepted into the Northern Lights accelerator (cohort starts Aug 1) and they require us to have an integration partner for LLM infra. We want to run a 6-week pilot that mirrors our planned production query distribution.

Ask: would Redwood be able to provide a pilot credit allocation (approx. $25k equivalent) and a 30-day trial extension on hosted API so our platform team can run load tests through the accelerator period?

Background: we are a seed-stage infrastructure startup (6 people, YC S22) building a low-latency embeddings retrieval layer. We can share our small security checklist and SOC2 attestation next week.

What we need from you to move fast: a short mutual action plan, confirmation of credit terms, and any simple AD/SSO/ingress guidance for the pilot.

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Founder & CTO
ByteForge Inc
+1 415-555-0148

Attachment: byteforge_accelerator_acceptance.pdf (stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@byteforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits & qualification for ByteForge accelerator

Hi Priya — great news on the cohort, congrats.

Short answer: we can support a pilot package but need to align internally on conditional terms. I’m looping in Marissa (programs) to confirm available credit bands and Ben (sales ops) for deal handling. To move quickly, can you share: 
- expected monthly token/embedding volume (rough ranges OK)
- SLA expectations during the pilot (p99 latency target, throughput)
- any special data residency or contract language your accelerator requires

If you can drop a short MAP (mutual action plan) in a Google Sheet or the attached MAP template, we’ll review and come back with an official conditional credit offer and a checklist for security artifacts.

Tentative internal ask: conditional $25k equivalent in hosted credits, 30-day trial extension, with a usage milestone at week 4 to convert to a pilot discount for Dedicated if needed. Final approval is subject to standard security sign-off (SOC2 doc or equivalent) and an executive sign-off on the MOU.

I can take a 20-min call tomorrow afternoon if that helps to finalize the MAP.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi team — looping in Programs & Partner Ops.

We can approve a conditional pilot grant up to $25,000 in hosted credits + a single 30-day trial extension under the following conditions (please confirm acceptance):
1) ByteForge signs the standard pilot MOU (I attached a draft).
2) ByteForge provides the SOC2 attestation or the SOC2-redacted.pdf and a filled security checklist prior to credits being applied.
3) A mutual action plan (MAP) is agreed within 5 business days with milestones at week 2 (connectivity), week 4 (load tests & milestone), and week 6 (pilot wrap + optional conversion discussion).
4) Credits expire 90 days after issuance if not converted to a committed Dedicated order.

Attachments: pilot_terms_draft.pdf (MOU draft), MAP_ByteForge.xlsx (MAP template).

Priya — if this looks OK I’ll send you an editable DocuSign-friendly MOU and request the SOC2 artifact. We generally try to avoid custom legal redlines for accelerator pilots to keep onboarding smooth.
